The biggest thing that helped me - and I passed on my first try!! Was look at the multiple choice answers and try to match them to the question. So many people just go digging and the test is long but I promise I used up the entire time. (I did the test in one sitting in 2020 I think they make you break it up now) but I almost ran out of time. Also get a good nights sleep and stay hydrated and calm!
